assumptions.text: Pre-shipment inspection priced at $268 per man-day.
assumptions.label: sourced

assumptions.text: AQL 0 / 2.5 / 4.0 for critical / major / minor is the usual consumer-goods setting; agree it with the buyer and factory.
assumptions.label: estimate

assumptions.text: One inspector checks about 100 units per day including functional tests.
assumptions.label: estimate

sample_size.label: estimate
sample_size.source_or_assumption: Per ISO 2859-1 table (edition not verified): Table I code letter K for lot 1,201–3,200, level General II, Table II-A

defects.description: Battery pack is swollen, leaking, visibly damaged, or becomes abnormally hot during operation or charging.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e1 (21.6 V (6S) rechargeable Li-ion battery pack with protection) / Certification: IEC 62133-2 / Certification: UN38.3
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; functional charge and run test with temperature monitoring — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Charging interface or wiring shows exposed live conductors, arcing, smoke, or burning odor during charging.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e5 (DC charging connector and charge interface) / Electronics block b6 (Charging interface)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection; functional charge test under controlled conditions — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Housing or wand has a sharp edge or burr that can cut the user during normal handling.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / BOM m2 (Aluminium wand)
defects.check_method: Visual and careful tactile inspection of accessible edges — AQL 0: accept ≤0 / reject ≥1 at n=125

defects.description: Top and bottom shell mating faces exceed the specified dimensional tolerance, preventing proper assembly or leaving a visible gap.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Shell mating faces ±0.1 mm
defects.check_method: Measure mating faces with calipers or a suitable gauge; inspect assembled fit — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Shell split-line step exceeds the specified limit or the assembled shell has a visibly uneven joint.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell) / Tolerance: Split-line step ≤ 0.1 mm
defects.check_method: Measure split-line step with a step gauge or feeler gauge — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Vacuum motor or floor head does not start, runs intermittently, or stops during normal operation.
defects.spec_ref: BOM e2 (High-speed BLDC vacuum motor assembly) / BOM m1 (Motorized floor head assembly)
defects.check_method: Functional run test using the trigger; verify motor and floor head operation — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Top or bottom shell finish is visibly inconsistent with the specified Satin · Nickel #9A9DA1 finish.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell)
defects.check_method: Visual comparison under D65 lighting at 50 cm; use colorimeter if available — AQL 2.5: accept ≤7 / reject ≥8 at n=125

defects.description: Cosmetic scratches, scuffs, or sink marks are visible on the shell but do not affect fit or function.
defects.spec_ref: Part p1 (Bottom shell) / Part p2 (Top shell)
defects.check_method: Visual inspection under D65 lighting at 50 cm — AQL 4: accept ≤10 / reject ≥11 at n=125

inspection_man_days.label: estimate
inspection_man_days.source_or_assumption: 125 samples at 100 units per man-day incl. functional tests

inspection_cost.label: estimate
inspection_cost.source_or_assumption: V-Trust rate (Sourced) × estimated man-days: 2 man-days (estimate) × $268/man-day (V-Trust, https://www.v-trust.com/en/our-network, checked 2026-09-26)
